title: Microsoft Edge: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat answers questions across multiple open tabs
notes: claim 70: severity blocker on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
the verifier wrote "hold" but listed no blocker and fewer than three majors; the claims decide, so the page is not held
summary: The controls, regional defaults and included licensing are supported, including the registry setting and cloud navigation flagged by the automatic checks. The impact rationale incorrectly says every eligible user gets wider context despite the documented user opt-out, and the example combining SharePoint, Outlook and a PDF in one answer goes beyond the published detail.

claims.claim: A single question can combine an intranet page, an Outlook Web App message and a PDF from different tabs into the same answer.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat Edge multiple open tabs contextual question SharePoint Outlook PDFs actions DLP unprotected pages'; read Edge 146 notes, the page-content table and Zero Trust summarization excerpt. No specific mixed-content, single-answer scenario found.
claims.fix: Replace the first sentence of Why it matters with 'Copilot Chat extends contextual questions from the open page to the user's open window.' In the first Data exposure bullet, replace 'including SharePoint intranet pages, Outlook Web App and PDFs' with 'where page access is permitted'. claims.claim: Sensitive web apps outside the described protection policies can remain readable by Copilot.
claims.quote: PDFs or sites for internal apps and services that are not protected by Microsoft Purview DLP policies, MAM policies, or MDM policies
claims.fix: Replace 'sensitive web apps outside those policies stay readable' with 'with page access enabled, internal app sites not protected by Microsoft Purview DLP, MAM or MDM policies can be summarized'. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/security/zero-trust/copilots/zero-trust-microsoft-copilot, which supplies that premise.

claims.claim: Microsoft describes no page actions introduced by this multi-tab context change.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat multi-tab contextual access actions read only page'; read Edge 146 announcements and page-context documentation. They describe answering and summarization, not new page actions; action-taking results concern the separate Cowork capability.

claims.claim: An administrator can verify the deployed EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext value at edge://policy.
claims.quote: On a target client device, open Microsoft Edge and go to edge://policy to see all policies that are applied.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/configure-microsoft-edge to sources for the general policy-verification instruction; the currently cited new-tab-page page demonstrates verification specifically for CopilotNewTabPageEnabled.

claims.claim: Every Edge for Business user with Copilot Chat in the side pane gets wider page context when the policy is unconfigured outside the EU.
claims.quote:
If you don't configure this policy:
- Access is enabled by default in non-EU regions.
- Access is disabled by default in EU regions.
- Users can turn this setting on or off in Microsoft Edge settings.
claims.fix: Replace the impact rationale with 'High. Edge for Business users with page access enabled get wider page context in Copilot Chat in the side pane; access is on by default outside the EU when the policy is unconfigured.' Existing user settings remain respected, so an unconfigured policy does not mean every user has access.
